profile.headline: Back-end developer | Golang | +15 years experience |  Always open to new challenges
profile.summary:
Hello, my name is Elohim, and I am a Java and Go back-end developer with over 12 years of professional experience. I have worked on a wide range of projects, including back-end, front-end, application, system-level, device driver, and embedded software development.

I am a self-driven developer capable of finding my way accros complex systems. I have experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including designers, product managers, and QA engineers. As a leader I seek to empower team members and share knowledge and tools for self-sufficiency. I thrive in dynamic environments where I can gather continuous customer feedback and quickly refine requirements and act on them.

If you have any questions or would like to discuss how I can contribute to your team, please don't hesitate to contact me at elohim.marron@gmail.com.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Build and maintain privacy enforcement infrastructure that ensures user consent and opt-out signals are honored across Meta's ads and monetization surfaces, spanning backend services, configuration systems, and ML data pipelines.
  - Lead cross-team migrations to consolidate privacy policy configurations, reducing duplicate rulesets and unblocking automated policy workflows for partner engineering teams.
  - Develop internal Hack/GraphQL services and React/Relay tooling that help engineers across the company verify their code and data flows meet privacy compliance requirements before shipping.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · PHP · C++ · Software Infrastructure · GraphQL · React.js · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Anthropic Claude · OpenAI Codex

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
- Successfully led initiatives to mitigate security risks and ensure service continuity by directing the migration of an outdated Redis cluster. This complex setup required manual transfer of metrics without downtime, thereby maintaining the security and efficiency of our telemetry system.
- As part of the Insights team, I contributed to the infrastructure maintenance of DigitalOcean's monitoring capabilities, which integrate comprehensive metrics gathering for over a milliion servers. This system allows for the real time processing of millions of metrics per second in a multi-region setup.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Ansible · Terraform · Prometheus.io · DigitalOcean · Cloud Computing · Databases · Metrics Reporting · Docker · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Senior Back End Developer
positions.description:
- Improved test coverage  in our repositories by about 20%, measured by a tool I added to some of our repos build procedures. I achieve this by aiming to improve coverage every time I added code and by instructing the team on good testing practices so coverage would not degrade over time.
- While acting as tech lead, team related customer bugs were reduced by 90% measured by our internal tools, this was achieved by switching focus to solving customer reported bugs and by improving the knowledge share between the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Scrum · SQL · Microservices · Rust (Programming Language) · MySQL · Go (Programming Language) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Python (Programming Language) · Java · Back-End Web Development · Metodologías ágiles · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
- Reduced delivery time for our product testable images from 1-2 weeks to same day by Implemented a CI system from scratch.
- Achieved the migration of our CI/CD from Jenkins to GitLab, this was validated by the successful implementation of the new system within tight time constraints and pressure from upper management, by means of early identifying possible risks and abstract tasks that could be performed by other members of the team.

positions.title: System Software Developer
positions.description:
- I reduced by about 15% the execution time of a benchmark for the time taken by inter instance communication on the distributed version of the Oracle database (I worked along another engineer on this). This was expected to translate to about a 2% max throughput increase on production systems. We achieve this by implementing a system that decreased context changes between user and kernel land.
- I performed maintenance and improvement tasks on the distributed version of the Oracle database. This was a very challenging task since this was a very complex legacy project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed the API for a new touch sensing configuration on the Freescale's library, allowing customers to use the library to create touch pads. I assure seamless integration with existing configurations, resulting in an enhanced user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Systems · Front-End Development · Custom Software Development

positions.title: Apps Engineer
positions.description: I developed an automotive demo using touch-sensing technology on microcontrollers. It was showcased at an international show (I did not attend the show).

positions.title: Apps Development Intern
positions.description: Successfully enabled customers to utilize non-supported memories in ARM microcontroller platforms by developing a tool for creating new configurations and creating application notes with instructions for adapting the platform. This solution expanded the capabilities of the platform and reduced the chances of customer facing compatibility problems.
